2f6b570.summary: Finds the minion that sits immediately to the right of a given minion across the left and right minion lists.

2f6b6fc.summary: Returns whether a minion's board position would be at the left of the given target position index.

2f6b91c.summary: Looks up a card in the left or right minion lists and returns its slot position on the board, logging an error if missing.

2f6bae8.summary: Hides the card shadow object by moving it to the zero position.

2f69f34.summary: Repositions all left and right minions to their slot positions and returns the longest resulting animation time.

2f6bc7c.summary: Scales a Vector3 board position by a manager value to adjust minion board position.

2f6bc9c.summary: Checks whether any left or right minion is more than a small distance away from its slot position.

2f6bef0.summary: Shifts existing minions aside to leave a gap while a new unit is dragged, and positions the card shadow in the closest slot.

2f69d00.summary: Converts a slot position to a board position by adding a scaled up vector.

2f6bb40.summary: Sets the card shadow's local position and optionally its rotation.

2f6c0ec.summary: Activates every left and right minion for the given turn and rebuilds the occupation lists.

2f6c1d0.summary: Removes a dead minion from the left or right minion lists and rebuilds occupation lists.

2f6c344.summary: Collects all in-play left and right minions into a list ordered by a key, with large amounts of inlined LINQ generic code.

2f6c640.summary: Calls RemoveSwarm on every in-play left and right minion except the given exception card.

2f6ca0c.summary: Counts the minions on the board, excluding those with the summonRift trait.

2f6b7d8.summary: Returns the one-based index of a card, negative for the left list and positive for the right list, or 0 if not found.

2f6cd48.summary: Returns the minion at a signed play index from the left or right list, logging a warning if the index is out of range.

2f6d0c0.summary: Sets the tooltip transform's position and stores it as the initial position.

2f6d108.summary: Shows a mini tooltip with the given text and title at a position and activates its game object.

2f6d2b4.summary: Hides the tooltip once enough time has passed since it was last hovered.

2f6d308.summary: Stores the target card, hides the mulligan text, updates button text and registers the change-card click listener.

2f6d448.summary: Removes the change-card click listener from the button when destroyed.

2f6d4d8.summary: Toggles the target card's mulligan selection and re-localizes the replace/undo text, mostly inlined localization code.

2f6d3cc.summary: Updates the mulligan button text to Undo or Replace by re-running the inlined localization process.

2f6d59c.summary: Hides the mulligan text object and checks the buttons group.

2f6d5e0.summary: Shows mulligan UI with instructions and first/second turn text, then sets up a mulligan button for each card.

2f6da50.summary: Finishes the mulligan when not disconnected: hides UI, notifies the battle manager, and destroys mulligan buttons.

2f6dac0.summary: Hides mulligan UI, tells the battle manager the mulligan is done, and destroys and clears mulligan buttons.

2f6df80.summary: Sets the mulligan button text to the seconds left counter.

2f6e010.summary: Toggles visibility of mulligan UI elements and fades the shade accordingly.

2f6e04c.summary: Shows the mulligan UI and restores the shade alpha after releasing the hide button.

2f6dcb8.summary: Shows or hides mulligan text, button and cards and sets the shade alpha accordingly.

2f6d7cc.summary: Instantiates a mulligan frame button over a card, registers it, and toggles the card's tooltips.

2f6dd8c.summary: Activates or deactivates the cards in the player's mulligan hand and the mulligan frame buttons.

2f6e0fc.summary: Starts each configured animation effect, playing it immediately or via a delayed coroutine, plus inlined effect handling for fades, sounds, particles and shake.
